Chell is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One. She only appears as a replacement character for  Alfira during the camp celebration if Alfira is dead.
“
Watch out Baldur's Gate. Chell's coming for you!
„
— Chell

Involvement

Act One

Chell only appears at the tiefling camp celebration, which happens during a long rest after successfully defeating the goblins threatening the Emerald Grove. She takes the place of Alfira if she is dead.

She appears as one of the dead tieflings at the Goblin Celebration in case the quest ⁠Raid the Emerald Grove was completed.

Idle banter

Chell being drunk and chatting with  Lakrissa (if she is present)

  • Chell
    Wish I could've kicked that goblin king in the head.
  • Lakrissa
    Hah. So ferocious.
  • Chell
    That's what I keep saying.
  • Lakrissa
    Have you ever fought a goblin before?
  • Chell
    A few.
  • Lakrissa
    Uh-huh. So the last one you took down... what was their name?
  • Chell
    Brian... Hobbleknob.
  • Lakrissa
    And what other evil creatures have you vanquished?
  • Chell
    I fought a goblin once. A big one.
  • Lakrissa
    Heh. Yes. You told me - in great detail.

 Zae telling Chell to dance but she is not into it

  • Chell
    It doesn't matter how many times you ask.
  • Zae
    Just TRY.
  • Chell
    No.
  • Zae
    COME ON.
  • Chell
    Dance somewhere else.
  • Zae
    BORING.
  • Zae
    Shake those hips! Let's go!
  • Chell
    Not a chance.
  • Zae
    UGH.
